sloka: समयम् च मम आर्य इमम् यदि त्वम् न करिष्यसि ।अग्रतः ते परित्यक्ता परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम् ॥२-१४-१०॥
transliteration: samayam ca mama ārya imam yadi tvam na kariṣyasi ।agrataḥ te parityaktā parityakṣyāmi jīvitam ॥2-14-10॥

translations.english: O noble one, if you do not fulfil the agreement, it will mean I have been abandoned by you. (Therefore) I will give up my life in your presence.
